description: This is an assembly source file for a specialized Neon-accelerated kernel used in quantized sparse matrix multiplication packing for ARMv7 architecture. It contains implementation of the function `pytorch_q8gemm_sparse_packA_ukernel_4x4__aarch32_neon`, which performs packing of matrix A into a format suitable for efficient sparse GEMM operations in PyTorch's QNNPACK library.

methods.name: pytorch_q8gemm_sparse_packA_ukernel_4x4__aarch32_neon
methods.description: Assembly implementation of a Neon-optimized kernel for packing a block of matrix A in sparse quantized GEMM, converting it into a format optimized for subsequent computations.
